The booking sites at Chicago hotels

57 sites, 8 of them at one hotel only. Most hotels listed: the hotel's own site at 16, Booking.com at 15 and Hotels In America at 14. Fewest sites: Chicago Marriott Downtown Magnificent Mile (9); most: Swissotel Chicago (27, as were 5 others).

Booking.com was lowest at Chicago Marriott Downtown Magnificent Mile of its 15, and 5%+ above another site at 14. Hotels In America was lowest at The Allegro Royal Sonesta Hotel Chicago Loop and Sofitel Chicago Magnificent Mile of its 14, and 5%+ above another site at 9. Etrip.net was lowest at The Hoxton, Chicago and InterContinental Chicago Magnificent Mile by IHG of its 13, and 5%+ above another site at 8.

The hotel's own site, at 16 of the 17: lowest at 1 (Chicago Marriott Downtown Magnificent Mile), a median 18% above the lowest site. Nearest: Swissotel Chicago, $258 against $248 on Super.com. Farthest: Le Méridien Essex Chicago, $311 against $168 on Super.com.

Lowest at 5%+ below the going rate: Super.com at 8, KAYAK.com at 3, Hotels In America at 2, br.Bluepillow.com at 1, Etrip.net at 1, goseek.com at 1, Hotelscombined.com at 1, momondo.com at 1 and 2 other sites at 2 between them (ties count for each). All cities: which booking site was lowest most often.

Taxes and fees in Chicago

They added a median of 18.9% ($43 a night) to the before-tax going rate. It ran from 15.1% at Warwick Allerton - Chicago to 19.1% at Hampton Inn Chicago Downtown/N Loop/Michigan Ave; our data does not split taxes from fees. The 8 listed prices may leave out resort or property fees. More: hotel booking fees explained.

Chicago, priced again a week later

Same stay, same Chicago hotels, 7 days apart, before tax; up and down mean more than 2%. Each stay links its CSV.

  • Oct 13 to Oct 15 stay, Sep 22 then Sep 29: 4 up, 6 down of 11; rose most Millennium Hotel Knickerbocker Chicago, $252 to $299; fell most DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Chicago - Alsip, $153 to $129; another site lowest at 7.
  • Oct 30 to Nov 1 stay, Sep 25 then Oct 2: 6 up, 8 down of 17; rose most Warwick Allerton - Chicago, $185 to $285; fell most Hilton Garden Inn Chicago Downtown Riverwalk, $282 to $237; another site lowest at 12.

Questions about Chicago hotel prices

How much is a hotel in Chicago?

$276 a night all-in at the median (Sep 25, 2026 prices), from $213 at Warwick Allerton - Chicago to $336 at InterContinental Chicago Magnificent Mile by IHG.

Does our data show the cheapest time to book a hotel in Chicago?

No: these prices come from a few Chicago dates, not a season. Sep 25 to Oct 2: 6 Chicago hotels rose more than 2%, 8 fell; Warwick Allerton - Chicago rose most, $185 to $285 before tax.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Chicago hotels?

Below the going rate, most often Super.com (8 hotels), KAYAK.com (3 hotels) and Hotels In America (2 hotels). The hotel's own site: lowest at 1 of 16.

How we measured this

The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price). The study's method. Words last changed November 23, 2026; prices read September 25, 2026; each hotel's page has every site's price in the newest snapshot that priced it.
